title: Microbial signaling coordinates group oviposition and predator defense in migratory locusts.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: no PMCID, no open full text, no supplement, no accessions in text or text-mined, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject), and the Zenodo/Dryad DOI search returned nothing.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything else is from the abstract: a mechanistic study of one bacterial volatile (2,4,6-trimethylpyridine) in locust eggs, its olfactory receptors (LmOR34, LmOR36, SinOR43a-1), a lysine-decarboxylase knockout, and behavioural assays with predators.

a1_downloadable.note: No deposited dataset found: no PMC full text, no supplement, no accessions, no repository hit for the DOI. Checked via paper_context.py only.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No table exists. The outcomes are behavioural choice assays and receptor electrophysiology for a single compound, not a labelled dataset.

a3_inputs_present.note: No inputs located. The study focuses on one molecule and a few receptors.

a4_units_stated.note: No data seen, so units can't be checked.

a5_enough_rows.note: A single-compound mechanism study; its behavioural assays likely have tens to hundreds of trials. Not verified.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Size isn't the problem; there is no data.

a8_label_provenance.note: Labels would come from real behavioural assays, but none are accessible.

honest_claim_h3: No ML claim is possible: the paper deposits no accessible dataset, and its core finding involves one molecule and three receptors.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use insect smell-receptor protein sequences to predict which odour compounds activate them.
plain_idea.train_on: Receptor sequences paired with odour compounds tested on them; this paper adds about 3 receptors and 1 compound. Number of examples: unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Whether a receptor responds to a compound, measured by electrophysiology or calcium imaging of receptors expressed in cells.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Pest-control chemists could screen candidate repellents without lab work. But this paper adds almost no labelled pairs, so it wouldn't serve as the training set.

ml_idea: None viable from this paper. A receptor–odour prediction project would need a large external resource of insect receptor–odour responses, which this paper doesn't provide.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: no data exists to load.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check the Cell paper's STAR Methods key resources table for any deposited data; paper_context found none.

verdict_reason: Paywalled mechanistic chemical-ecology study with no deposited dataset, supplement or accessions, and no labelled table. It is centred on one volatile compound and three receptors, so it fails A1, A2 and A5.
